title: The Wisdom of Life
summary: Schopenhauer's practical guide to a bearable life: happiness depends mostly on what you are (health, mind, character), less on what you have and least on what others think of you. Avoid pain rather than chase pleasure, learn to enjoy solitude, limit your desires, and stop letting other people's opinions run your life.
